Publish.LongDescription:
# Asset Database Contributor Help crowdsource asset data for the SkylinQ Asset Database.
# IMPORTANT: Please read before subscribing... Help build the public SkylinQ Asset Database by contributing information about the mods you have installed.
## This mod connects to the Asset Database server By subscribing to this mod, you acknowledge that it can communicate with the online Asset Database server to upload asset information after you have given your consent.
This mod requires Simple Mod Checker Plus installed and active to access SMC's categorisation of subscribed mods.
### Why contribute? The SkylinQ Asset Database (work-in-progress, can be accessed from https://cities2.starq.fyi) is built entirely from community contribution. Every player who chooses to participate helps improve the database for everyone.
On first launch, you will be asked whether you want to contribute.
If you agree, you'll be given two options: - Anonymous contribution: only asset data is uploaded. - Public contribution: your user information is also uploaded so your contributions can appear on the public leaderboard. This is completely optional.
### Then what? After consent is given, the mod will: - Check whether the server requires data. - Scan your subscribed mods for missing asset/map/file information. - Verify randomly selected packages using Simple Mod Checker Plus to ensure they match the published PDX Mods version. - Randomly choose up to 100 verified packages. - Extract the required asset data, localization, icons and other metadata. - Upload the collected information to the SkylinQ server.
### What data is uploaded? The uploads include various data about subscribed mods. No local assets or runtime generated assets are processed. The following data is extracted from your game: - Prefab asset data - Map data - Mod file list - Images used on the prefab and map
If you choose Public contribution, your user information (PDX Username and UserId) is also included so your contributions can be credited publicly.
# TL;DR - No gameplay data is uploaded. - Only uploads asset-related information. - User identity is optional. - Consent can be revoked from the Options UI. - Uploads happen in the background only before opening a map in that session (Save or Editor).
Publish.ChangeLog: - Map package data are now contributed. - Locales now only export real content, no fallbacks. - File list for each verified mod packages (including what's inside zips) are now contributed. - Assets with custom components are no longer rejected. - Assets with custom components requires the dependent mod to be present before it's contributed. - Component data is now imported directly from the server instead of relying on mod updates. - Improved performance both on mod-side and server-side.
